dev.description: Stratified random sample of train, used only for hyperparameter choices. Final models are refit on all of train.

sweep.description: Stratified random sample of train minus dev, used for the LoRA learning-rate sweep.

learning_curve.description: k examples per class from train minus dev, nested across k, one draw per seed.

test_dedup.method: Nearest train item by cosine similarity of character 3-5 gram TF-IDF vectors (scikit-learn TfidfVectorizer, analyzer='char_wb', lowercase, fit on train and test). A test item is removed when its nearest train item has similarity >= 0.90 and the same label.
